# HERMES TV (AGENTROPOLIS)

HERMES TV is a local-first smart TV agent interface for Android TV and
Google TV, in development by AGENTROPOLIS. It connects a television to a
Hermes agent runtime that the user owns and controls. Agents execute on
the user's host, not inside the website.

Status as of 2026-10-20: IN DEVELOPMENT. No APK is published. There is
no downloadable build and no running hosted service.

Canonical pages:
- This site: https://agentropolis-city-of-agents.github.io/AGENTROPOLIS-HERMES-TV-WEB-/
- Machine-readable fact sheet: /facts.json (same origin)
- Public web repository: https://github.com/AGENTROPOLIS-CITY-OF-AGENTS/AGENTROPOLIS-HERMES-TV-WEB-
- TV client repository: https://github.com/AGENTROPOLIS-CITY-OF-AGENTS/AGENTROPOLIS-HERMES-TV

License: Apache-2.0 (see the LICENSE file in the public web repository).

What is NOT claimed: no released app, no published APK, no voice feature
yet, no compatibility results yet. The roadmap on the main page lists
planned milestones, not shipped features.
